name: slushpile
description: An adversarial job search that gets better as it goes: pool-anchored fit scoring, a resume and cover letter built against the job description, seven agents that try to reject you before a recruiter does, and a profile that keeps what they find.

plugins.name: slushpile
plugins.description: Nine skills and eight agents that run a job application and feed what the review finds back into your profile. The skills: onboard, search and score roles, interview for undocumented experience, build the resume and letter, adversarially review them, de-slop the prose, restyle the templates, report the queue and its calibration, and answer what to run next.
